summary_rationale: Cirrus Logic operates a high-margin, capital-light fabless mixed-signal engineering franchise with 52.8% FY2026 GAAP gross margins, 23.0% GAAP operating margins, $1.15 billion in year-end cash and marketable securities ($1.08 billion exiting Q2 FY2027), zero financial debt, and exceptional cash conversion ($636.61 million FY2026 free cash flow, 31.9% of sales). Deep multi-year co-engineering in custom 22nm smart codecs, boosted amplifiers, haptic drivers, and multi-generation camera controllers creates genuine technical switching costs and multi-year product lifecycles. However, the franchise fails the test of an autonomous compounder: single-customer reliance on Apple rose from 79% of net sales in FY2017 to 91% in FY2026 and 93% in Q2 FY2027, top-line growth averaged just 2.9% annually over the past nine fiscal years ($1.54B to $2.00B), diversification into PCs and general-market mixed-signal remains too small to offset smartphone seasonality or component-shortage delays, and past M&A (such as the $85.8 million FY2023 intangible impairment on Lion Semiconductor) highlights execution friction outside the flagship smartphone customer. Business quality is therefore rated CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL with PASS_WITH_WATCH KPI health: economically elite while its flagship sockets hold, but structurally exposed to single-customer concentration and periodic smartphone cycle air-pockets.
